senses.gloss:
n. (-षं)
Happiness, felicity, pleasure, enjoyment, satisfaction.
f. (-षा)
A woman: see योषा; also जोषित्, जोषिता, &c.
E.
जुष to delight, affix घञ्, fem. affix टाप्.

ind.
1 Silently.
2 In happiness, delightedly at ease, &c.
3 Well, excellently.
4 Excessively, beyond bounds.
E.
जुष to please or be pleased, affix अम्.

f. (-का)
A bud, a germ.
E.
जुष to please, affix वुन्, and fem. form; some copies have more accurately perhaps कोषिका.

f. (-षित्)
A woman.
E.
जुष to delight, affix इति; also योषित्, जोषिता, &c.

f. (-ता)
A woman.
E.
जुष to please, affix क्त; also योषित, योषिता, &c.
